::: {#rem-prediction-error}
#### Prediction errors and residuals

The prediction in @def-prediction-error can be a [fitted value](#def-fitted-value)
or a prediction for an observation that was not used to fit the model.
Prediction error is oriented the same way as
[estimation error](#def-estimation-error):
estimate minus true value.
For an observation that was used to fit the model,
the prediction error is the negative of the [residual](#def-residual):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\prederr_i
&= \fitted_i - y_i
&& \text{(definition of prediction error)}\\
&= -(y_i - \fitted_i)
&& \text{(factor out $-1$)}\\
&= -\resid_i
&& \text{(definition of residual)}
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
